entries.title: A task that tells an issue how work ended waits for work that actually ships
entries.body: A task that replies to an issue or closes it no longer starts when the work it waits on ended without any change merging, such as a plan or a bug check. It stays waiting, follows the work built on that plan, and your first mate hears once when nothing shipped, instead of a crewmate starting only to say there is nothing to tell.
entries.noPicture: This changes when an existing task starts, not how any view looks.
